name: uk-drone-airspace
description: Where can I legally take off and fly a drone in the UK? Flight restriction zones, live NOTAMs, public rights of way and landowner rules.
long_description: Answers the three questions a UK drone pilot needs before a flight: is this point inside a flight restriction zone or other permanent restriction (NATS UK AIP ENR 5.1), is there a NOTAM in force (live NATS bulletin), and can I legally take off here (nearest public rights of way, National Trust land, known council byelaws). Place names, postcodes and landmarks are geocoded for you. Permanent data is a compact SQLite pack refreshed every AIRAC cycle and downloaded on first use.
